BC scratches: Scottish Lassie from Distaff + more
BC scratches: Scottish Lassie from Distaff + more
HRN staff
October 28, 2026 3:37pm
 Photo:
Candice Chavez / Eclipse Sportswire
 For the second year in a row, Scottish Lassie is scratched from the Breeders' Cup Distaff , bringing the field to eight.
 The Breeders' Cup announced the scratch on social media but did not provide a reason.
 Trained by Jorge Abreu, Scottish Lassie was 15-1 on the morning line for the Distaff. The 4-year-old McKinzie filly had her first start in June after an 8 1/2-month layoff, winning an optional-claiming allowance at Saratoga. She then was second to Fully Subscribed in both the  Grade 2 Shuvee and the Personal Ensign (G1).
 Scottish Lassie had one work at Keeneland to prepare for the race, breezing four furlongs in 49.0 seconds Saturday.
 Last year, she was scratched two days ahead of the Distaff, with Abreu saying she had a problem with her right foot after training the day before.
 Also scratched is Go For Launch from the Juvenile Fillies Turf, clearing the way for Silent Beauty to join the field of 14.
 Zulu Kingdom was scratched from the Mile, Induction is out of the Juvenile Turf, and Gaudreau was scratched from the Juvenile, bringing the field to seven.
 Evershed was scratched from the Filly & Mare Turf, allowing Vina Arana to enter the field. Vina Arana is removed as an also-eligible for the Mile.
 And Test Score was scratched from the Breeders' Cup Turf, moving in Map of Stars.
